name: Aetherbound
author: AfterWorld
short: An active original anime adventure RPG.
description: Active anime RPG with tutorials, 13 monsters, two bosses, shared boss encounters, class mechanics, gear sets, rune sockets, forging, quests, a dungeon and daily shops.
install_msg: Load with [p]load aetherbound. An admin runs [p]aetherset setup to create channels/roles and enable spawns. See the README for required permissions. Begin with [p]aether create vanguard Your Name. Phase 1 gameplay: use [p]aetherset guides after updating to refresh the welcome and channel examples.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server Discord user IDs, chosen character names/descriptions, progression, inventory and binding/lock flags, active combat, shared-boss participation/level/damage/reward-claim records (retained up to seven days after encounter expiry), trade message/thread IDs, and timestamped economy changes (gold, potions, materials, created/destroyed item IDs and action labels). Supports Red user data export/deletion, including economy records. Discord messages and roles are managed separately by Discord.
